description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the accuracy or correlation scores for three different tasks—Sentiment Accuracy (light yellow), STS Correlation (pink), and Paraphrase Accuracy (light blue)—across five distinct model configurations along the horizontal axis: Single-task_baseline, Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout, Unsupervised_SimCSE, Supervised_SimCSE, and 2-Tier SimCSE. The vertical axis, labeled "Accuracy / Correlation," ranges from 0 to 0.8 in linear increments, with grid lines at intervals of 0.2. Each model configuration has three adjacent bars representing the three metrics. For the Single-task_baseline, the Sentiment Acc. bar reaches approximately 0.54, the STS Corr. bar is at about 0.51, and the Paraphrase Acc. bar is the tallest at approximately 0.79. In the Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout group, Sentiment Acc. is around 0.53, STS Corr. is approximately 0.58, and Paraphrase Acc. is about 0.78. The Unsupervised_SimCSE group shows Sentiment Acc. at approximately 0.53, STS Corr. rising to about 0.71, and Paraphrase Acc. at approximately 0.77. The Supervised_SimCSE group exhibits Sentiment Acc. at approximately 0.49, STS Corr. peaking at about 0.80, and Paraphrase Acc. at approximately 0.78. Finally, in the 2-Tier SimCSE group, Sentiment Acc. is approximately 0.49, STS Corr. reaches its highest point at approximately 0.81, and Paraphrase Acc. is approximately 0.78. The bars are not sorted and are visually grouped by model configuration. There is no visual emphasis or annotation on any specific bar beyond the color-coded legend indicating which metric each bar represents.
